sloka: धनुर् विस्फारमाणस्य यस्य शब्देन लक्ष्मण ।स शैला कम्पिता भूमिः सहायैः किम् नु तस्य वै ॥४-३६-९॥
transliteration: dhanur visphāramāṇasya yasya śabdena lakṣmaṇa ।sa śailā kampitā bhūmiḥ sahāyaiḥ kim nu tasya vai ॥4-36-9॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana the twang of his bow shook even the mountains and the earth. What assistance does he need?
